digest.component_or_area: LLM structured-output runner and retry infrastructure
propositions: Every structured-output consumer must route through the single PydanticAIRunner facade (get_runner(...).run(...)), verified by mode-resolving AST census across src/ and scripts/
The sole structured-output implementation uses bounded in-Agent retries (retries={"output":N}) within one agent.run_sync call per output mode, eliminating bespoke fresh-Agent retry loops

The output-retry allowance N is seeded from structured_retry_limit and constrains both Agent retries and UsageLimits request-budget addend to prevent request exhaustion before output-repair retry depletion
structured_retry_limit=0 produces zero output-repair retries (single-shot), preserving the batch abstain fail-safe at overlap/judge.py and contracts.py
A well-formed first response triggers exactly one outer agent.run_sync call; only the bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade produces a sanctioned second run
All existing provider fallback order, tool limits, timeout ownership, provenance, output shapes, and seeded-history behaviors remain functionally unchanged
